description.zh: 修改后的网关描述。长度限制0~255个字符。
description.en: The new description of the gateway. The description can be 0 to 255 characters in length.

description.zh: 修改后的网关名称。长度限制1~60个字符，可以包含大小写字母，中文，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”，同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头。
description.en: The new name of the gateway. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw modify-gateway --gateway-id gw-0001xv7je3580031y000 --name alex000 --description For_testing --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sgw ModifyGateway --region cn-hangzhou --Description For_testing --GatewayId 'gw-0001xv7je3580031y000' --Name alex000
